svg.aria-label: VisualAssist: an iPhone app for low-vision users, in Swift. Inside 0.5 metres the phone interrupts — a continuous haptic at full strength and speech that names the direction and the distance; at 2.0 metres it is deliberately silent. No live link — it needs an iPhone with a lidar sensor.
